tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtor bsngo brgya rtsa 'bring po gsog thabs nyung gsal sgron me bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ brtse chen thugs rjes ma rungs tshar gcod phyir/ /rab 'jigs spyan rtsa bsgyur ba'i glog phreng gis/ /mi bzad bdud sde'i g.yul ngo rab bcom nas/ /thub bstan rgyas mdzad dam can rgya mtshor 'dud/ /de mnyes byed pa'i gang zag gis/ /grangs can mchod gtor bya ba'i tshul/ /dpal ldan mtshungs med e waṃ pa'i/ /phyag len 'bring po'i tshul 'dir spel/ /dbang thob dam ldan bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i gang zag gis dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po gur zhal lcam dral sogs la gtor bsngo brgya rtsa bya bar 'dod pas/ phyag len 'bring po'i rnam dbye cung zad bshad na/ rgyun gtor lnga tshar dang de'i mdun du gsog rgyu'i gtor ma lnga tshar gcig dang / de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga dang bcas bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams la/ gnas khang byin brlab bam/ mchod pa byin brlab tsam mdzad na legs/ de nas dpal kyai rdo rje'i lam dus thun bsdu ba'i bar grub rjes/ lnga tshar gong 'og gnyis ka la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs te/ gtor bsngo bzlas pa bshags pa bcas grub 'phral/ lnga tshar 'og ma rnams la mtheb skyu gnyis re gsos te nang mchod sogs kyis sbyangs la/ mtheb skyu bcu ka la byin rlabs rgyas pa tshar gcig bya/ de nas phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya gsum dang / de bzhin du shā sa na dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā lī de wī sogs lan gsum res phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa sogs kyang ji lta ba bzhin byas/ bstod pa dpal ldan mkha' 'gro sogs nas/ nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / 'dod khams dbang phyug sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ slar yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hris byin rlabs dran par byas la sngags gsum gyis 'bul ba sogs sngar ltar bya ste mtheb skyu bcu po ma rdzogs kyi bar dang /

slar yang mtheb skyu bcu bsnon pa sogs 'dra zhing / de lta bu'i brgya tshar song ba dang / mtheb skyu bcu gcig bsnan te 'bul bas brgya dang bcu gcig phul 'gro ba yin/ de'i tshul gyis gur la brgya tshar song ba dang / yang mtheb skyu bcu re bsnan te byin rlabs rgyas pa dang / oṃ ma hā ka la sogs kyis 'bul ba dang / bstod pa gong gi mthu stobs sogs bya ba rnams gong gi rigs 'gre sbyar ste las mgon sogs la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya zhing / thun bsdu ba'i tshe gtor bsngo gang yin ji ltar song mtshams su dpal ldan mgon po sogs 'bul gtor 'bul ba'am/ de min kol+la i rar+ṭhā nas brtsams te bsdu chog rnams gtor bsngo dkyus ma ltar mdzad pas 'thus lags/ bkra shis// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gtor bsngo brgya rtsa 'bring po gsog thabs nyung gsal sgron me/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
